entities.summary: Hennadiy Viktorovich "Gennady" Razin is a Ukrainian former professional ice hockey defenceman who last played for HC Donbass of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by the Montreal Canadiens in the 5th round of the 1997 NHL Entry Draft.
